title: joserfc: Compact JWS size guard allocates attacker-controlled segments before rejection (CVE-2026-119284)
description: A vulnerability in joserfc 1.7.4 allows attacker-controlled segments to be allocated in memory before size validation rejects them. This occurs because the library calls bytes.split() on the input before checking its length, causing an additional allocation roughly the size of the payload. This undermines the intended size guard and can lead to excessive memory usage. The issue is fixed in version 5.2.5.
